excludedMatches.title: Breathe (한숨)
excludedMatches.reason: Removed from proposals because the retrieved upload channel is YG Family Tube and the evidence did not establish rights-holder ownership or distribution.

limitations: Metadata-only audit, not playback or waveform comparison. Video labels and duration differences do not establish whether the added time is dialogue or instrumental/visual edit. No Japan-chart alternate met the exact-recording and official-audio verification threshold in this pass. No catalogue, video ID, audio file, database, Git state, server, or index was modified.

remainingAuditSummary.notProposed: For the other screened MV sources, cache and targeted Topic/official-audio search yielded no exact artist/title rights-holder or distributor audio record; same-title cover tracks and third-party uploads were excluded.
